comment: Digest pin for the vendored release-status schema (copy-never-move: the gateway's standards corpus stays the authored authority; this copy is a vendor, repinned only by a deliberate edit to this record). Repinning discipline: recompute sha256 against the origin bytes at the new origin commit and update source+sha256 together in one commit. Fold R6 (2026-10-02): the origin citation is a gateway MAIN commit — the digest was measured byte-identical at the slice-2 branch tip and at main (638256957baf…), so citing the unmerged branch tip was the fragile form; the re-citation moved source only, never bytes or sha256.
